reason_codes.meaning: An exact operative provision establishes commencement on publication at or before the cutoff.
An exact fixed commencement date is at or before the cutoff.
An exact fixed commencement date is after the cutoff, so the locations remain in the Waiting Room.
A current exact appointment establishes commencement at or before the cutoff.
A current exact appointment names a date after the cutoff.
Exact evidence establishes that the commencement condition was satisfied at or before the cutoff.
The exact commencement condition is not satisfied at the cutoff.
Exact evidence commences only the named Legal Locations at or before the cutoff.
An exact partial commencement is scheduled after the cutoff and changes no location yet.
The exact operative provision, authentic event evidence, publication date, effective date, appointment, or condition proof is incomplete.
The accepted commencement evidence or controlling notice chain conflicts or is unresolved.
The claimed whole or partial affected Legal Location set is not exact, bounded, and consistent with prior operative state.
